messages:
Anna: Heads up — saw a 8-12ms tail latency regression on long-sequence (>1024) streaming requests after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak. Repro on prod and staging.
Sam: ugh. any specific model or seq len?
Anna: Most visible on llama-13b / seq=2048, single-stream. p50 unchanged, p95/p99 up. CI perf tests also show +9ms median for that config.
Lee: do we have a bisect candidate? which CL changed selector?
Anna: CL: rwd/runtime@a3f9c2 changed kernel router for short-vs-paged thresholds. I suspect the selector now prefers flash_paged more often for certain lengths.
Ravi: can we force kernels to isolate? e.g. env var REDWOOD_ATTENTION_KERNEL=flash_fused vs flash_paged and re-run the bench?
Anna: good idea. ran quick compare on staging:

```
# single-stream, seq=2048, llama-13b
REDWOOD_ATTENTION_KERNEL=flash_paged ./bench_attn --model llama-13b --seq 2048 --streams 1
p50 12.3ms p95 28.7ms p99 41.2ms

REDWOOD_ATTENTION_KERNEL=flash_fused ./bench_attn --model llama-13b --seq 2048 --streams 1
p50 11.1ms p95 19.0ms p99 22.4ms
```
Sam: wow flash_fused is way better on tail there. That points at flash_paged path regression.
perf-bot: perf-run 1766001250 finished. artifacts: https://perf.redwood/local/1766001250/attn/compare.html
Lee: also check KV cache behavior — paged attention interacts with KV page thrashing on large seq + multi-turn. Maybe selector picks paged when it shouldn't.
Ravi: added a quick microprofile:

```
# nvprof-like sampling -> main hotspots
flash_paged kernel: warp divergence + memcopy 45%
flash_fused kernel: lower divergence, faster load 18%
```
Anna: that aligns. memcopy + small memcpy bursts in paged path causing scheduler delays. Batching heuristics also changed: default max_batch_delay reduced from 3ms to 1ms in the same CL. Could explain more small batches hitting paged slow path.
Sam: action items: 1) revert selector change (a3f9c2) behind a flag 2) force kernel to flash_fused for affected models in prod as hotfix 3) dig into memcopy in paged kernel and batching interaction
Lee: I'll cut a quick canary flag PR to gate selector and re-run perf suite.
Ravi: I'll profile kernels with full flamegraphs and capture GPU memcopy stacks. Linking when ready.
Anna: temporary prod knob applied (force=flash_fused) — observing p99 drop back to baseline in the next 10m.
Sam: nice. please paste the PR link and perf diff when available. :thumbsup:
Anna: PRs: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/492 (selector gate), https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/493 (prod knob). Perf diff: https://perf.redwood/diff/1766001250_vs_1766001320
perf-bot: noted regression label added to issue rwd-2132.
Lee: thanks everyone. we should add a regression test for seq=2048 single-stream in CI perf matrix so selector changes don't regress silently.
Anna: adding test now, will follow up in the PR.
Ravi: leaving notes in the kernel impl about memcopy hotspots + possible rewrite to async copies to avoid stalls.
Anna: cool — closing triage for now, reopening if the canary shows anything odd. :white_check_mark:
